question: 统计不同生产线的平均缺陷率，并按缺陷率从高到低排序
sql: SELECT production_line, AVG(defect_rate) AS avg_defect_rate FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY avg_defect_rate DESC
description: 按生产线聚合平均缺陷率并排序

question: 统计各产品的平均良率
sql: SELECT product_type, AVG(first_pass_yield) AS avg_first_pass_yield FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY avg_first_pass_yield DESC
description: 按产品类型聚合平均良率

question: 查询停机时长最长的设备
sql: SELECT machine_id, SUM(downtime_minutes) AS total_downtime_minutes FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY machine_id ORDER BY total_downtime_minutes DESC LIMIT 10
description: 按设备汇总总停机时长并取前十

question: 统计不同班次的平均质量得分
sql: SELECT shift, AVG(quality_score) AS avg_quality_score FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY shift ORDER BY avg_quality_score DESC
description: 按班次聚合平均质量得分

question: 统计各生产线的总产量
sql: SELECT production_line, SUM(production_volume) AS total_production_volume FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY total_production_volume DESC
description: 按生产线汇总产量

question: 找出故障次数最多的设备
sql: SELECT machine_id, SUM(fault_event_count) AS total_faults FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY machine_id ORDER BY total_faults DESC LIMIT 10
description: 按设备汇总故障次数并取前十

question: 按产品类型统计平均缺陷率和平均良率
sql: SELECT product_type, AVG(defect_rate) AS avg_defect_rate, AVG(first_pass_yield) AS avg_first_pass_yield FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY product_type ORDER BY avg_defect_rate DESC
description: 按产品类型同时统计缺陷率与良率

question: 统计每条生产线上有多少台设备
sql: SELECT production_line, COUNT(DISTINCT machine_id) AS machine_count FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY machine_count DESC
description: 按生产线统计去重后的设备数量

question: 各生产线的平均设备利用率是多少
sql: SELECT production_line, AVG(machine_utilization) AS avg_machine_utilization FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY avg_machine_utilization DESC
description: 按生产线聚合平均设备利用率

question: 缺陷率高于 5 的生产记录有多少条
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fact_production_record WHERE defect_rate > 5
description: 按阈值筛选并计数

question: 良率低于 90 的记录数量
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fact_production_record WHERE first_pass_yield < 90
description: 按良率阈值筛选并计数

question: 停机时间超过 30 分钟的记录有多少条
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fact_production_record WHERE downtime_minutes > 30
description: 按停机时长阈值筛选并计数

question: 设备利用率低于 60 的设备有哪些
sql: SELECT DISTINCT machine_id FROM fact_production_record WHERE machine_utilization < 60 ORDER BY machine_id
description: 筛选低利用率设备并去重

question: 质量得分最高的 10 条生产记录
sql: SELECT record_id, quality_score FROM fact_production_record ORDER BY quality_score DESC LIMIT 10
description: 按质量得分降序取前十

question: 各生产模式的平均缺陷率
sql: SELECT operation_mode, AVG(defect_rate) AS avg_defect_rate FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY operation_mode ORDER BY avg_defect_rate DESC
description: 按生产模式聚合平均缺陷率

question: 各批次的总产量前十名
sql: SELECT batch_id, SUM(production_volume) AS total_production_volume FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY batch_id ORDER BY total_production_volume DESC LIMIT 10
description: 按批次汇总产量并取前十

question: Line_A 的平均缺陷率
sql: SELECT AVG(defect_rate) AS avg_defect_rate FROM fact_production_record WHERE production_line = 'Line_A'
description: 单产线条件下的平均缺陷率

question: Night 班次的平均质量得分
sql: SELECT AVG(quality_score) AS avg_quality_score FROM fact_production_record WHERE shift = 'Night'
description: 单班次条件下的平均质量得分

question: M01 设备的总停机时长
sql: SELECT SUM(downtime_minutes) AS total_downtime_minutes FROM fact_production_record WHERE machine_id = 'M01'
description: 单设备条件下的总停机时长

question: 缺陷率的最大值和最小值
sql: SELECT MAX(defect_rate) AS max_defect_rate, MIN(defect_rate) AS min_defect_rate FROM fact_production_record
description: 全表极值

question: 平均单位生产成本是多少
sql: SELECT AVG(production_cost_per_unit) AS avg_production_cost_per_unit FROM fact_production_record
description: 全表平均成本

question: 平均综合效益得分是多少
sql: SELECT AVG(benefit_score) AS avg_benefit_score FROM fact_production_record
description: 全表平均效益得分

question: 各生产线缺陷率的标准差
sql: SELECT production_line, STDDEV_POP(defect_rate) AS defect_rate_std FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY defect_rate_std DESC
description: 按生产线计算总体标准差

question: 各生产线上 Product_A 的产量合计
sql: SELECT production_line, SUM(production_volume) AS total_production_volume FROM fact_production_record WHERE product_type = 'Product_A' GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY total_production_volume DESC
description: 多条件筛选后分组汇总
